```{python}
from pathlib import Path


def find_project_root(start):
    path = Path(start).resolve()
    for candidate in (path, *path.parents):
        if (candidate / ".unaltraweb" / "computations.yml").is_file():
            return candidate
    raise RuntimeError("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")


def points_attribute(points):
    return " ".join(f"{x},{y}" for x, y in points)


width = 1240
height = 700
cards = [
    {
        "x": 35,
        "title": "Selecció o extracció",
        "question": "Quines entitats coincideixen?",
        "result": "Geometria completa",
        "fields": "Atributs d’A",
        "mode": "selection",
    },
    {
        "x": 430,
        "title": "Retall (clip)",
        "question": "Quina part queda dins de B?",
        "result": "Part interior a B",
        "fields": "Atributs d’A",
        "mode": "clip",
    },
    {
        "x": 825,
        "title": "Intersecció",
        "question": "Quina part comparteixen A i B?",
        "result": "Part comuna A ∩ B",
        "fields": "Atributs d’A i B",
        "mode": "intersection",
    },
]

svg = [
    f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{width}" height="{height}" viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
    '  <title id="title">Diferència entre selecció espacial, retall i intersecció</title>',
    '  <desc id="desc">Tres panells parteixen de la mateixa línia A que travessa el polígon B. La selecció conserva la línia completa, el retall conserva només el tram interior i la intersecció conserva el mateix tram però combina els atributs de les dues capes.</desc>',
    '  <defs>',
    '    <style>',
    "      .bg { fill: #f5f7f8; }",
    "      .card { fill: #ffffff; stroke: #c8d3d9; stroke-width: 2; }",
    "      text { font-family: Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; }",
    "      .title { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .subtitle { font-size: 22px; fill: #52616b; }",
    "      .heading { font-size: 25px; font-weight: 700; fill: #17202a; }",
    "      .body { font-size: 22px; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .small { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; fill: #33434c; }",
    "      .map { fill: #f8fafb; stroke: #d9e1e5; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .mask { fill: #76b7d8; fill-opacity: .34; stroke: #2878a5; stroke-width: 3; }",
    "      .mask-context { fill: #76b7d8; fill-opacity: .12; stroke: #7ba8bd; stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 7 5; }",
    "      .source { fill: none; stroke: #d65f43; stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }",
    "      .source-context { fill: none; stroke: #9aa8af; stroke-width: 5; stroke-linecap: round; }",
    "      .result { fill: none; stroke: #b53e29; stroke-width: 9; stroke-linecap: round; }",
    "      .chip-geometry { fill: #e6f1f6; stroke: #8eb9cc; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    "      .chip-fields { fill: #f7e8d2; stroke: #d5a768; stroke-width: 1.5; }",
    '    </style>',
    '    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="11" markerHeight="11" refX="8" refY="3.5" orient="auto" markerUnits="strokeWidth">',
    '      <path d="M0,0 L0,7 L9,3.5 z" fill="#52616b"/>',
    '    </marker>',
]

for index, card in enumerate(cards):
    x = card["x"]
    output_mask = [
        (x + 115, 410),
        (x + 305, 425),
        (x + 280, 540),
        (x + 140, 555),
    ]
    svg.extend([
        f'    <clipPath id="result-clip-{index}">',
        f'      <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}"/>',
        '    </clipPath>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  </defs>',
    f'  <rect class="bg" width="{width}" height="{height}"/>',
    '  <text x="35" y="46" class="title">Un mateix predicat, tres tipus de resultat</text>',
    '  <text x="35" y="76" class="subtitle">La línia A interseca el polígon B; l’operació decideix si es conserva l’entitat o se’n construeix una part nova.</text>',
])

for index, card in enumerate(cards):
    x = card["x"]
    input_mask = [
        (x + 115, 185),
        (x + 305, 200),
        (x + 280, 315),
        (x + 140, 330),
    ]
    output_mask = [
        (x + 115, 410),
        (x + 305, 425),
        (x + 280, 540),
        (x + 140, 555),
    ]
    input_line = f'M {x + 50},300 C {x + 135},280 {x + 215},205 {x + 350},220'
    output_line = f'M {x + 50},525 C {x + 135},505 {x + 215},430 {x + 350},445'
    svg.extend([
        f'  <rect x="{x}" y="100" width="380" height="555" rx="12" class="card"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 24}" y="138" class="heading">{card["title"]}</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 24}" y="168" class="subtitle">{card["question"]}</text>',
        f'  <rect x="{x + 24}" y="182" width="332" height="154" rx="8" class="map"/>',
        f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(input_mask)}" class="mask"/>',
        f'  <path d="{input_line}" class="source"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 63}" y="322" class="small">A</text>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 270}" y="224" class="small">B</text>',
        f'  <line x1="{x + 190}" y1="350" x2="{x + 190}" y2="385" stroke="#52616b" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrow)"/>',
        f'  <rect x="{x + 24}" y="407" width="332" height="154" rx="8" class="map"/>',
    ])
    if card["mode"] == "selection":
        svg.extend([
            f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}" class="mask-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="result"/>',
        ])
    else:
        svg.extend([
            f'  <polygon points="{points_attribute(output_mask)}" class="mask-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="source-context"/>',
            f'  <path d="{output_line}" class="result" clip-path="url(#result-clip-{index})"/>',
        ])
    svg.extend([
        f'  <rect x="{x + 24}" y="579" width="332" height="28" rx="14" class="chip-geometry"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 190}" y="600" text-anchor="middle" class="small">{card["result"]}</text>',
        f'  <rect x="{x + 24}" y="614" width="332" height="28" rx="14" class="chip-fields"/>',
        f'  <text x="{x + 190}" y="635" text-anchor="middle" class="small">{card["fields"]}</text>',
    ])

svg.extend([
    '  <text x="620" y="687" text-anchor="middle" class="subtitle">Seleccionar respon quines entitats; retallar o intersectar respon quina geometria exacta.</text>',
    '</svg>',
])

project_root = find_project_root(Path.cwd())
output = project_root / "assets/img/generated/06-analisi-geoprocessament-vectorial/selection-overlay.svg"
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text("\n".join(svg) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
```
